item.title: Nashville Mayor Freddie O'Connell invites residents to hear Community Safety Plan initiative
item.description: He’s kicking off the initiative with a series of meetings for residents. The mayor's office is collaborating with the Metro Public Health Department to give residents more of a voice in their communities.

item.title: Pets of the Week for March 24, 2026
item.description: Looking for a new pet? Check out News 2 “Pets of the Week” segment every Tuesday on Good Morning Nashville.

item.title: Tennessee businesses optimistic despite economic uncertainty, survey finds
item.description: Tennessee business leaders are heading into the middle of 2026 with continued optimism, even as tariffs and artificial intelligence (AI) reshape parts of the business landscape, according to a new University of Tennessee survey.

item.title: Nashville 'Night Mayor' on how night life has evolved beyond Broadway
item.description: Music City is three years into having an Office of Nightlife with Director Benton McDonough at the helm.

item.title: Hendersonville could still get utility tunnel from Boring Company
item.description: Hendersonville did not win The Boring Company's (TBC) contest for cities looking for a tunnel but it might end up with a tunnel project anyway.

item.title: 1 injured after shooting on West End Avenue
item.description: Officers were called to the 2700 block of West End Avenue near Centennial Park just before 11 p.m.

item.title: Family files lawsuit after deadly school bus crash in Carroll County
item.description: The family of one of the two children killed in a bus crash in Carroll County last week has filed a lawsuit against the school district and bus driver.

item.title: Multiple suspects sought after attempted ATM theft at Murfreesboro bank
item.description: Authorities are searching for multiple suspects accused of using stolen vehicles to rip an ATM from its foundation Friday morning at a Murfreesboro bank.

item.title: Fridays by the River kicks off spring season in Shelby Park
item.description: The Friends of Shelby Park and Bottoms' spring season of Fridays by the River kicks off this afternoon in East Nashville.

item.title: Man found guilty of aggravated rape in Maury County
item.description: More than four years after a young woman was raped while she was having seizures, a Maury County man was convicted Wednesday in connection with the case.

item.title: Smyrna residents upset about noise, light pollution from nearby commercial property
item.description: People living in Smyrna's Lake Farm Estates area said they’re upset about a commercial development creating noise and light pollution throughout the day and night.

item.title: Police in Middle TN, Southern KY work together to find man accused of stealing from the elderly
item.description: A career criminal with a history of stealing from senior citizens, as well as active warrants in Tennessee and Kentucky, is back behind bars.

item.title: NFD crews extinguish fire that damaged 2 Old Hickory homes
item.description: Crews with the Nashville Fire Department fought a house fire in Old Hickory Friday afternoon that spread to a neighboring home.

item.title: States struggle to regulate prediction markets
item.description: Who will win the election? Where will interest rates land? How will a basketball game end? Prediction markets don't call putting money behind those answers — and that may be the most important detail legislatively.

item.title: 'Scammers are opportunists': What to watch out for to avoid tax scams
item.description: As the deadline to file draws near, the Internal Revenue Service has warned taxpayers to be on alert for scams designed to steal your money and personal information.
